boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Oxford-campus environments for independent work, writing, research, collaborative projects, and focused study.

cards.title: King Library
cards.subtitle: 151 S. Campus Ave. · Oxford campus
cards.notes: Set up with your own materials, then use the library’s computers, printing/scanning, collections, or a reservable room as your work requires.
cards.short_summary: Miami’s main library combines collections, computing, printing, and reservable study infrastructure.
cards.evidence_claim: King Library provides study-room reservations, computer labs, printing/scanning, technology checkout, and library collections.
cards.access_notes: Use during current King Library operating hours; room use requires the Libraries reservation system.

cards.title: Reserve a King Library Study Room
cards.subtitle: King Library · Oxford campus
cards.notes: Reserve a room for a focused partner session or group task, and plan around the two-hour daily reservation limit before arriving.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms with technology for quiet work, collaboration, and group projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Miami Libraries offers King Library study-room reservations; reservations are limited to two hours per day and may be made up to two weeks ahead.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the Miami Libraries system; individual and group reservations are limited to two hours per day.

cards.title: Sidley Lounge
cards.subtitle: King Library · first floor
cards.notes: Choose the open common room for independent work, or arrange an after-5 p.m. checkout for the enclosed conference, classroom, or breakout spaces.
cards.short_summary: A King Library lounge with comfortable workspaces and flexible, technology-equipped rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Sidley Lounge has an open common room with seating and workspaces plus a classroom, conference room, and breakout space; enclosed facilities open for checkout after 5 p.m.
cards.source_title: Unveiling of the new Sidley Lounge | Miami University Libraries
cards.access_notes: The lounge is open during King Library business hours; its classroom, conference room, and breakout space are available for checkout after 5 p.m.

cards.title: King Library Sensory Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: King Library · quiet area
cards.notes: Reserve one of these rooms when a sensory-friendly setting would support your work; each accommodates one to four users.
cards.short_summary: Two reservable sensory-friendly rooms designed for focused work in a quiet library area.
cards.evidence_claim: King Library has two reservable sensory study rooms in a quiet area, designed for students who benefit from a sensory-friendly space and accommodating 1–4 users.
cards.source_title: Oxford Campus Sensory Spaces and Wellness Rooms | Miami University
cards.access_notes: Reserve through Miami Libraries; rooms accommodate one to four users.

cards.title: Honors/Scholars Study Room
cards.subtitle: King Library 227 · ID access
cards.notes: If you are an Honors or Scholars student, bring your Miami ID and use this designated room for a focused study session.
cards.short_summary: A designated King Library study room for Honors and Scholars students.
cards.evidence_claim: King Library 227 is an Honors/Scholars Study Room available exclusively to Honors and Scholars students through ID access.
cards.source_title: Faculty and Graduate Reading Room | Miami University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Restricted to Honors and Scholars students; use your Miami ID to enter.

cards.title: Polk-Patterson Graduate Reading Room
cards.subtitle: King Library · graduate-student access
cards.notes: Graduate students doing sustained research can request a locker assignment, then use this shared reading-room setting alongside library resources.
cards.short_summary: A shared King Library reading room intended for in-depth, library-resource-based research.
cards.evidence_claim: Faculty and Graduate Reading Rooms support in-depth study and research using library resources; actively enrolled graduate students are eligible for use and lockers.
cards.source_title: Faculty and Graduate Reading Room | Miami University Libraries
cards.access_notes: For actively enrolled graduate students; locker assignments require the linked annual request form and are first come, first served.

cards.title: Wertz Art & Architecture Library
cards.subtitle: Alumni Hall · ground and basement floors
cards.notes: Use the individual or group seating when working with visual-arts material, and reserve one of the library’s three study rooms for enclosed work.
cards.short_summary: A visual-arts library with design software, technology checkout, seating, and reservable rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Wertz Art & Architecture Library in Alumni Hall offers ample individual and group seating, three reservable study rooms, and design-discipline technology and software.
cards.source_title: Wertz Art & Architecture Library | Miami University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on the ground and basement floors of Alumni Hall; reserve study rooms through Miami Libraries.

cards.title: Armstrong Student Center Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Armstrong Student Center · 550 E. Spring St.
cards.notes: Reserve a quiet room for individual or group work, then collect the key at the information desk with your Miami ID within 15 minutes.
cards.short_summary: No-cost, reservable study rooms for current Miami students working alone or in groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Armstrong study rooms are available at no cost to current Miami students for quiet study and group projects, with reservations through Miami Libraries.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms | Armstrong Student Center | Miami University
cards.access_notes: Current Miami students only. Reserve up to two hours daily; present Miami ID at the information desk to collect the room key.

cards.title: Carruthers Commuter Resource Center
cards.subtitle: Armstrong 2045 · second floor
cards.notes: Commuting students can plug in, use the study area, and store essentials in a free locker while working between Oxford-campus commitments.
cards.short_summary: A commuter-focused Armstrong space with study areas, charging, lockers, and kitchenette facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Carruthers Commuter Resource Center offers commuting Oxford-campus students seating and study areas, charging stations, and free lockers.
cards.source_title: Commuter Center | Armstrong Student Center | Miami University
cards.access_notes: For students commuting to the Oxford campus; listed availability is 7 a.m.–7 p.m. and the center closes during specified university breaks and summer closure.

cards.title: Makerspace at King Library
cards.subtitle: King Library · third floor
cards.notes: Bring a project that benefits from making or digital media work, then use the hands-on equipment and ask staff for guidance on available tools.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative experiential-learning space with fabrication, media, and digital-creation equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: King Library’s third-floor Makerspace is a hands-on, collaborative, experiential learning space with 3D printers, CNC mills, sewing machines, VR headsets, and other equipment.
cards.access_notes: Located on King Library’s third floor. Check current library guidance for equipment availability and any required training or appointments.
